name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)

eligibility.additional_rules: Farmer families holding cultivable land up to 2 hectares (5 acres). Institutional landholders and tax-paying families excluded.

benefits: ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly transferred into bank account.
application_steps: 1. Verify land ownership records. 2. Link Aadhaar with bank account. 3. Register via PM-KISAN portal or CSC center.

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana)

eligibility.additional_rules: Low income household listed under SECC database or holding BPL/Ration Card. No age cap.

benefits: Health insurance cover up to ₹5,000,000 (₹5 Lakhs) per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
application_steps: 1. Check eligibility on PM-JAY portal or at empanelled hospital. 2. Verify identity via Aadhaar & Ration Card. 3. Receive Ayushman Card.

name: PMAY-G (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin)
target_audience: Rural houseless families and those living in kutcha/dilapidated houses

eligibility.additional_rules: Must not own a pucca (permanent) house anywhere in India.

benefits: Financial assistance of ₹120,000 in plain areas and ₹130,000 in hilly/difficult areas for house construction + MGNREGA wage support.
application_steps: 1. Identification through Gram Sabha & SECC data. 2. Verification of land ownership/site. 3. Direct fund release in installments linked to construction stages.

name: PMEGP (Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme)

eligibility.additional_rules: At least 8th pass for manufacturing projects above ₹10 Lakhs or service projects above ₹5 Lakhs.

benefits: Subsidized credit for setting up new micro-enterprises with government margin money subsidy ranging from 15% to 35% of project cost.
application_steps: 1. Prepare detailed project report (DPR). 2. Submit online application on KVIC portal. 3. Interview by District Task Force Committee & Bank loan sanction.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
target_audience: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools

eligibility.additional_rules: Must be engaged in one of the 18 specified traditional trades (carpenter, blacksmith, weaver, barber, tailor, cobbler, etc.).

benefits: Recognition ID card, skill training with ₹500/day stipend, toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, and collateral-free loans up to ₹300,000 at concessional 5% interest.
application_steps: 1. Biometric registration on PM Vishwakarma portal via Common Service Centre. 2. Three-tier verification (Gram Panchayat / ULB, District, Screening). 3. Training & loan disbursal.

name: PM Mudra Yojana (Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana)

eligibility.additional_rules: Valid business plan for micro-enterprise in manufacturing, trading, or service sector.

benefits: Collateral-free micro loans up to ₹1,000,000 (₹10 Lakhs) under three categories: Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishore (₹50k-5L), Tarun (₹5L-10L).
application_steps: 1. Choose loan category (Shishu/Kishore/Tarun). 2. Submit application with business plan to nearest empanelled bank or NBFC.

name: PMMVY (Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana)

eligibility.additional_rules: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for their first live child. Regular government employees excluded.

benefits: Direct cash incentive of ₹5,000 in instalments upon fulfilling ANC registration, child birth registration, and initial immunization.
application_steps: 1. Register pregnancy at Anganwadi Centre or health facility within 150 days of LMP. 2. Submit Form 1A with MCP Card & Aadhaar details.

name: IGNOAPS (Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme)
target_audience: Senior citizens belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households

eligibility.additional_rules: Must be 60 years or older and possess valid BPL certificate/card.

benefits: Monthly pension of ₹200/month (60-79 years) and ₹500/month (80+ years), often supplemented by state top-ups (up to ₹1,000–₹3,000/month).
application_steps: 1. Obtain BPL certification from local Panchayat / Municipality. 2. Submit pension application form to Social Welfare office.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
target_audience: Students belonging to SC, ST, or OBC categories studying in Class 11 and above

eligibility.additional_rules: Studying in a recognized post-secondary institution. Combined annual family income under ₹2.5 Lakhs (SC/ST) or ₹1.5 Lakhs (OBC).

benefits: 100% compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursement + monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month.
application_steps: 1. Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP). 2. Fill student profile & upload fee receipts. 3. Institute verification & DBT disbursal.

name: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
target_audience: Street vendors vending in urban areas on or before March 24, 2020

eligibility.additional_rules: Street vendors possessing Certificate of Vending or ID Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).

benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan starting at ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy.
application_steps: 1. Check name in ULB vendor survey list. 2. Apply on PM SVANidhi portal or app. 3. Direct loan approval by bank.

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
target_audience: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas

eligibility.additional_rules: Loanee and non-loanee farmers growing Kharif, Rabi, or annual commercial crops.

benefits: Crop loss protection against natural calamities with nominal farmer premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for Commercial/Horticultural crops.
application_steps: 1. Apply before cut-off date via bank, CSC, or portal. 2. Pay nominal premium contribution. 3. In case of crop loss, report within 72 hours.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
target_audience: Parents or legal guardians of girl child below 10 years of age

eligibility.additional_rules: Account can be opened for up to 2 girl children per family from birth up to 10 years of age.

benefits: High tax-free interest rate (8.2% p.a.), Section 80C tax deduction, deposit from ₹250 up to ₹1.5 Lakh/year, matures after 21 years.
application_steps: 1. Fill SSY account opening form at Post Office or authorized bank. 2. Submit Birth Certificate & Guardian KYC. 3. Deposit initial amount.

name: Subhadra Yojana
target_audience: Eligible women residents of Odisha state aged 21 to 60 years

eligibility.additional_rules: Must be resident of Odisha. Income must be under ₹2.5 Lakhs. Tax-paying or government-employed women excluded.

benefits: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year given in two equal installments of ₹5,000 each (on Raksha Bandhan and International Women's Day) for 5 years (Total ₹50,000).
application_steps: 1. Collect printed application form free from Mo Seba Kendra / Anganwadi. 2. Submit completed form with Aadhaar e-KYC. 3. Direct DBT transfer.

name: NAPS (National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme)
target_audience: Youth seeking skill training and workplace apprenticeship

eligibility.additional_rules: Minimum 5th/8th/10th/12th pass depending on designated trade.

benefits: Government reimbursement of 25% of prescribed stipend up to ₹1,500 per month per apprentice + National Apprenticeship Certificate.
application_steps: 1. Register candidate profile on Apprenticeship Portal. 2. Search & apply for apprenticeship opportunities in establishment. 3. Sign online apprenticeship contract.
